Landing.title: Understand your chart.
Landing.subtitle: Discover your Vedic birth chart and explore what it traditionally says about relationships, work, and other parts of your life.
Landing.ctaNote: Start with your birth details. No astrology knowledge needed.
Landing.seoIntro: A Vedic birth chart maps the positions of celestial bodies at the time and place of birth. Jyotish calculates chart placements and helps you explore how they are interpreted in traditional Vedic astrology.
Landing.seoBody1: Enter your birth date, time and place and Jyotish works out your Lagna (ascendant), Rashi (Moon sign), Nakshatra (one of the 27 lunar mansions) and your current Vimshottari Dasha. From there you can ask about the topics you care about — relationships, work, money or matching two charts.
Landing.seoBody2: Readings are drawn from your own chart and the current planetary positions, and explained in everyday language. Vedic astrology is a traditional interpretive framework rather than a science — its readings are offered for reflection, not as fixed predictions.
Landing.faq1A: A Kundli is a map of where the planets were at your exact birth moment. It shows your Lagna (ascendant), Rashi (Moon sign), Nakshatra and Dasha periods, which are used in traditional Vedic astrology to interpret life themes.
Landing.faq2Q: How is my birth chart calculated?
Landing.faq2A: Jyotish computes your chart with the Swiss Ephemeris, using the sidereal zodiac and the Lahiri ayanamsa, from the date, time and place you enter. It works out your Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra and current Vimshottari Dasha in seconds.
Landing.faq3Q: Do I need my exact birth time?
Landing.faq3A: No. If you don't know it, we use 12:00 PM. Your Rashi and Nakshatra stay reliable, and the reading still works for most questions — though a house-based reading can shift with a few minutes' difference.
Landing.faq4Q: Is Arya an AI or a human astrologer?
Landing.faq4A: Arya is an AI. Every reading and reply is generated by an AI model from your chart details, and no human astrologer reviews it before you see it. AI can be wrong — treat readings as traditional interpretation for reflection, not as fact.
Landing.faq5Q: What happens to my birth details?
Landing.faq5A: Your birth details are used to calculate your chart and keep your readings consistent. They are stored securely, never sold, and you can ask us to show or delete your data at any time. See the Privacy Policy for the full detail.
Landing.faq6Q: What's free, and what do I pay for?
Landing.faq6A: Your Vedic chart is free to calculate, and you get free questions before any payment. After that, question packs are a one-time purchase — the questions never expire. Payments are handled by Razorpay and we never see your card details.

Terms.lagna: Lagna (ascendant) is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth. It shapes your personality and body.
Terms.rashi: Rashi is your Moon sign — the sign the Moon was in at birth. It reflects your mind, emotions and inner nature.
Terms.nakshatra: A Nakshatra is one of 27 lunar mansions the Moon occupies. It adds deeper flavour to your Moon sign.
Terms.dasha: Vimshottari Dasha divides your life into planetary periods. Each period's lord colours the events of those years.
Terms.planet: The 9 planets (navagraha) each rule different areas of life — Sun (career/authority), Moon (mind), Venus (love), etc.
Terms.house: Houses are the 12 life areas in a chart. The 1st is self, 7th is marriage, 10th is career, 11th is gains.
Terms.retrograde: A retrograde planet appears to move backwards in the sky. It turns a planet's energy inward or makes it slower.
